verdict.rationale: Crossplane's docs say that when resources drift from the desired state, the control plane automatically corrects the drift [crossplane-docs-18]. Continuous reconciliation of this kind requires detecting the drift first. Community comments describe active controllers that react to failures [crossplane-comm-3] and a control plane that enforces declared config [crossplane-comm-10]. Missing for 10: documentation on how detected drift is surfaced or reported to the platform engineer, an observe-only or detect-without-remediate mode, and independent hands-on corroboration of drift detection.
